_doc: v3 settings for the hetzer (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from hetzer_prep.json (work dir hetzer_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/hetzer_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: hetzer

source.title: Hetzer (LRM) for battletech
source.author: PrysmaTheMagical
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 9, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. RIGHTS: PrysmaTheMagical, "Hetzer (LRM) for battletech" (Thingiverse 6459522), labelled CC BY-SA 4.0; built from two Cults3D models of unverified licence; rights unverified; Lee accepted the risk on 2026-10-31. The fit is level (`no_icp`, v1 yaw 270). WHEELED, 2 axles, 4 OWN GEOMETRY wheels (`make_wheel`) on the kit's wheel arches (kit wheel faces cut from the hull), front pair under `steer_*`. The kit carries LRM tube banks fixed on the hull top; the original has one cannon and max_turret_yaw 0, so no turret or gun part. Welded at 3 mm, planar-dissolved at 1.5 degrees, collapse above 80k faces.
